title: Commercial quantity vs small quantity - why it changes everything
p1:
A few grams can decide the entire direction of a legal case.

Many people assume the amount of a substance only affects the punishment. The reality is that quantity can change the entire legal framework.
p2: A common misconception is that possession is possession, no matter the amount. But under drug laws, the difference between a small quantity and a commercial quantity can mean the difference between a relatively minor offence and much stricter consequences.
p3:
The law creates quantity-based categories to distinguish personal use from large-scale activity. Commercial quantity cases often involve tougher bail conditions, higher penalties, and a more serious legal process.

The practical lesson: in such cases, the exact measurement matters. A small difference in quantity can create a major difference in legal risk.
conclusion: Did you know that the quantity involved can completely change how a legal case is treated? What other legal factors do you think people commonly misunderstand?
